attributes.scope: src/game/enemy/critter.c only, commit 30f9cb9fc. No semantic change - all 64 eligible labels were checked programmatically and every emitted literal re-packs to the identical IEEE bit pattern read from orig/GUNE5D/sys/main.dol at that label's address (shortest round-tripping decimal, f suffix on f32 labels).
